summary: The open AI model ecosystem spans model repositories like Hugging Face—which crossed 3 million public models in August 2026—and a growing set of developer-facing inference platforms that let teams run open-weight models via simple APIs without managing infrastructure. These range from local-first runtimes (Ollama) to serverless GPU inference and hosted open-model APIs (Together AI, Fireworks AI, SiliconFlow, Replicate), distinct from enterprise aggregators and full MLOps suites. Notably, download activity is highly concentrated: roughly half of Hugging Face models have fewer than 200 downloads, while the top 200 models account for nearly half of all downloads.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The central hub for hosting, sharing, and discovering open models, datasets, and demos (Spaces), plus serverless and dedicated inference endpoints.
platforms.model_count: Over 3 million public models (crossed 3M in August 2026)
platforms.pricing: Free tier for hosting and limited inference; PRO at ~$9/mo; Inference Endpoints and dedicated compute billed per hour/usage; Enterprise plans available
features: Largest open model and dataset registry
Transformers, Diffusers, and other open-source libraries
Serverless Inference API and dedicated Inference Endpoints
Spaces for hosting demos and apps
Model cards, download/usage stats, and community collaboration
Git-based versioning for repos
platforms.best_for: Researchers, ML engineers, and developers needing the broadest selection of open models, datasets, and collaboration tooling

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: A local-first runtime for downloading and running open LLMs on your own machine (laptop, workstation, or server) with a simple CLI and API.
platforms.model_count: Hundreds of curated models in its library (Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Qwen, DeepSeek, Phi, and more)
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; no cloud fees since it runs locally (cloud/hosted options emerging)
features: One-command model pulls and runs
Cross-platform (macOS, Linux, Windows)
Local REST API compatible with OpenAI-style calls
GGUF-based quantized models for consumer hardware
Modelfile customization for prompts and parameters
Offline, privacy-preserving inference
platforms.best_for: Developers and hobbyists who want private, offline, local inference and easy experimentation without cloud costs

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: A cloud platform to run and deploy open models (LLMs, image, video, audio) via API, and to package custom models as reproducible containers.
platforms.model_count: Thousands of community and official models across modalities
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use billed by compute time (per-second GPU/CPU usage); no subscription required
features: Run models with a single API call
Cog framework for packaging custom models into containers
Broad multimodal coverage (text, image, video, audio)
Automatic scaling and cold-start handling
Simple webhooks and streaming support
platforms.best_for: Developers who want to quickly integrate or deploy diverse open models, especially generative media, without managing GPUs

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: A developer inference cloud offering fast, scalable APIs for open models plus fine-tuning and dedicated GPU clusters for training and serving.
platforms.model_count: 200+ open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, FLUX, and more)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for inference (tiered by model size); hourly pricing for dedicated endpoints and GPU clusters; fine-tuning billed by usage
features: High-throughput, low-latency optimized inference
OpenAI-compatible API
Fine-tuning and custom model hosting
Dedicated endpoints and GPU clusters for training
Broad open-model catalog across text, vision, and image
Serverless and reserved compute options
platforms.best_for: Startups and enterprises building production apps on open models who need performance, scalability, and fine-tuning in one platform

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: A performance-focused inference platform for serving open LLMs and multimodal models with very low latency and high throughput at production scale.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models plus custom model deployment
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for serverless inference; per-GPU-hour pricing for dedicated deployments; fine-tuning billed by usage
features: Highly optimized serving stack (FireAttention and speculative decoding)
OpenAI-compatible API
Function calling and structured/JSON output support
LoRA fine-tuning and custom model hosting
Dedicated and on-demand GPU deployments
Multimodal and embedding model support
platforms.best_for: Teams prioritizing speed, cost-efficiency, and reliability for latency-sensitive production inference on open models

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: A cost-competitive inference cloud (with strong presence in Asia) offering API access to a wide range of open text, image, audio, and video models.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models including DeepSeek, Qwen, Llama, FLUX, and audio/video models
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token / pay-per-use with competitive rates; free credits and some free model tiers
features: OpenAI-compatible API
Broad multimodal catalog (LLM, image, TTS/ASR, video)
Optimized serving for low-cost high-throughput inference
Dedicated deployment options
Strong support for leading Chinese open models
Fine-tuning support
platforms.best_for: Developers seeking affordable, multimodal open-model inference, particularly those building on DeepSeek/Qwen and serving Asia-Pacific markets

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: A unified API gateway that routes requests across many model providers (open and proprietary), letting developers access hundreds of models through one endpoint.
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token passthrough pricing with a small routing margin; prepaid credits; no subscription
features: Single OpenAI-compatible API for many providers
Automatic fallback and provider routing by price/latency
Unified billing across providers
Access to both open-weight and closed models
Usage analytics and model comparison
platforms.best_for: Developers who want flexibility to switch between models/providers without integrating each one separately

platforms.name: Groq
platforms.purpose: An ultra-low-latency inference platform using custom LPU hardware to serve open LLMs at exceptionally high token-generation speeds.
platforms.model_count: Dozens of curated open models (Llama, Mixtral, Gemma, Qwen, and others)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token inference pricing; free developer tier with rate limits; enterprise plans
features: Custom LPU hardware for extreme throughput
OpenAI-compatible API
Industry-leading tokens-per-second speeds
Low, predictable latency for real-time apps
Curated selection of popular open models
platforms.best_for: Developers building real-time, latency-critical applications (voice agents, chat) on open models
